profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ServiceTitan
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack developer with years of experience using .NET technologies and more to deliver complex domain-centric applications that are robust and well-tested. I am passionate about continuously growing my knowledge and honing my skills to produce better results than ever before.

Skills:
- Expert knowledge: .NET Framework, C#, ASP.NET Web API, ASP.NET MVC, MongoDB, TDD, Agile. 
- Working knowledge: Docker, Javascript, Typescript, SQL Server, SSIS, AWS, TeamCity, Octopus Deploy, SignalR, RabbitMQ.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead for developing, support, and expanding VPS NICU, a major company offering.
- Developing and maintaining rest of company portfolio.
- Delivered a modular, extensible, event-based Web API/SignalR platform to enable rapid development of new company offerings, including the aforementioned VPS NICU.
- Automated previously-manual domain processes by creating internal tools.
- Reviewed remedial procedures to ensure company compliance with security certifications.
- Expert knowledge: .NET Framework, C#, ASP.NET Web API, ASP.NET MVC, MongoDB, TDD, Agile.
- Working knowledge: Docker, Javascript, Typescript, SQL Server, SSIS, AWS, TeamCity, Octopus Deploy, SignalR, RabbitMQ.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Expert Services Developer
positions.description:
- Delivered client solutions on Episerver platform in a timely manner with efficiency and quality and applying development best practices.
- Provided architecture design and technical guidance throughout the entire project lifecycle.
- Troubleshooted client issues in performance and functionality.
- Educated team members on product and development insights.
- Technologies included: Microsoft .NET Framework 4.5.2, C# 5.0, ASP.NET MVC 5, SQL Server 2012/2014
- Services and APIs: Episerver Commerce 7-9, Episerver CMS 6-9, Lucene

positions.title: Software Engineer / Commerce Product Developer
positions.description:
- Integrated the Mediachase e-commerce product into the Episerver ecosystem and improved existing functionality for increased reliability.
- Improved the back-end commerce management portal, focusing on systems for catalog, customer, order, and marketing management.
- Shipped the first production version of the multi-warehouse feature, which was a highly-requested feature.
- Technologies included: Microsoft .NET Framework 4/4.5, C# 5.0, ASP.NET 4 Web Forms
- Services and APIs: Episerver Commerce 1/7, Lucene, Solr

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Facilitated automated testing by developing daily TFS builds for the flagship product, an e-commerce framework, to .
- Developed and troubleshooted client e-commerce sites with a focus on the commerce components to provide 
- Enabled clients to easily trial the product by developing an installer to use as a springboard for projects.
